clog-1: Biyaha suuligu ma daadanayaan gabi ahaanba waxayna ku dhow yihiin inay buuxdhaafaan
clog-2: Waxyaabo qalaad (masaxadaha qoyan, cadayga, furka) ayaa ku dhacay musqusha
clog-3: Saxanka jikada wuxuu leeyahay ur xun biyuhuna way fadhiisanayaan
clog-4: Biyo ayaa ka buuxdhaafaya dhuumaha saxanka hoostiisa ama bullaacadda sagxadda
clog-5: Bullaacadda sagxadda musqusha waxaa xiray timo waxayna keenaysaa buuxdhaaf
clog-6: Qolka dharka / bullaacadda balakoonka waxay soo celinaysaa xumbo iyo biyo
clog-7: Khadka ugu weyn ee bullaacadda dhismaha ama meesha godka biyaha ayaa xirmay
clog-8: Waxaa loo baahan yahay baaritaan dhuumaha lagu sameeyo iyadoo la adeegsanayo kamarad
clog-9: Waxaa loo baahan yahay nadiifinta dhuumaha iyadoo la adeegsanayo biyo cadaadis sarreeya leh
clog-10: Dhibaatooyinka dhuumaha ku xiran booska wasakhda iyo soo noqoshada biyaha
clog-11: Dhuumaha qashin-qubka oo ay xireen saliid adkaatay
clog-12: Nadiifinta dabinada dufanka ee maqaayadda iyo furista dhuumaha
leak-1: Biyo ayaa ka daadanaya ama qoynaya saqafka/derbiga qolka hoose
leak-2: Saacadda biyaha way wareegaysaa xitaa marka aan wax biyo ah la isticmaalayn
leak-3: Waraaqda derbiga, sagxadda alwaaxa, ama derinadu way qoyan yihiin waxaana galay caaryo
leak-4: Isku-xirka qasabadda biyaha ayaa si joogto ah biyo uga daadanayaan
leak-5: Salka musqusha ama qalabka taangiga biyaha ayaa dillaacsan oo biyo ka daadanayaan
leak-6: Dhuumaha biyaha oo ku dillaacay qabowga jiilaalka ama saacad barafowday
leak-7: Biyo daxal cas leh ama carro/wasakh ayaa ka imaanaya qasabadda
leak-8: Dhuumaha kuleyliyaha ama waalka qeybiyaha kuleylka ayaa biyo ka daadanayaan
leak-9: Biyaha roobka oo ka soo gelaya dildilaaca dibadda ama dahaarka daaqadda
leak-10: Waxaa loo baahan yahay qalab casri ah oo cod ama gaas ah si loo ogaado dillaaca yar
leak-11: Cadaadiska biyaha ayaa aad u hooseeya, waxaana loo baahan yahay bamka kordhiya cadaadiska
leak-12: Beddelidda guud ahaan dhuumihii hore iyo dib-u-sameynta ka-hortagga biyaha ee sagxadda musqusha
bl-1: Kuleyliyaha wuu shidan yahay, laakiin qolku ma kululaanayo gabi ahaanba
bl-2: Biyo kulul ma jiraan xilliga qubeyska, biyo qabow kaliya ayaa soo baxaya
bl-3: Koodhka qaladka ayaa ka biligleynaya qalabka heerkulka qolka gudaha
bl-4: Biyo ayaa ka daadanaya gudaha kuleyliyaha ama dhuumaha hoose
bl-5: Dhawaaq weyn ama guxid marka uu kuleyliyuhu bilaabmo
bl-6: Urta gaaska ama qiiqa baxaya oo soo gelaya qolka
bl-7: Bambo wareegga oo xumaatay; biyo ayaa la maqlayaa laakiin kuleyl ma jiro
bl-8: Codsi qiimeyn ah oo loogu talagalay kuleyliye gaas cusub oo deegaanka u wanaagsan
bl-9: Qalabka heerkulka qolka oo jabay ama qalabka dhaqaajiya furaha oo cilladoobay
bl-10: Maydhista dhuumaha kuleylka (ka saarista wasakhda) iyo saarista hawada ayaa loo baahan yahay
bl-11: Kormeerka & dayactirka kuleyliyaha saliidda / korontada / pellet-ka
bl-12: Dhalaalinta dhuumaha kuleyliyaha ee qaboobay & dib-u-rakibidda dahaarka
clean-1: Nadiifinta ka hor intaan la degin studio/officetel (Jeermis-dil buuxa)
clean-2: Ka saarista dufanka adag ee shooladda/daboolka jikada & weel-dhaqaha
clean-3: Caaryada dhoobada musqusha, qolofka biyaha & jeermis-dilista musqusha
clean-4: Ka saarista boodhka mashiinka daaqadda, shabaqa & nadiifinta muraayadaha labada dhinac
clean-5: Kala-furida gudaha talaajadda, ku nadiifinta uumiga & ka saarista urta cuntada
clean-6: Kala-furida qaboojiyaha, maydhista shaandhada & ka saarista caaryada biraha qaboojiyaha
clean-7: Kala-furida foosto-dhaqaha, jeermis-dil qoto dheer & ka saarista haraaga
clean-8: Mashiin ku xoqidda sagxadda, ka saarista wasakhda & marinta laakada ilaalinta
clean-9: Ka saarista cayayaanka furaashka/fadhiga dharka & ku maydhista biyo qoto dheer
clean-10: Nadiifinta qolka qashinka buuxo (Daabulidda qashin badan & ka saarista urta)
clean-11: Nadiifinta dhismaha kadib (Ka saarista boodhka sibidhka, dhibcaha rinjiga)
clean-12: Ka saarista dhogorta/urta xayawaanka & buufinta jeermis-dilaha dabiiciga ah

h-2: Guri u furan dadka haysta aqoonsiga ajnabiga & fiisada sharciga ah
h-3: Qalabaysan (Dhaqidda dharka, Qaboojiye, Qaboojiyaha hawada, Kuleyliye/Jiko ku jiraan)
h-4: Qandaraas wakhti gaaban (3 ilaa 6 bilood) oo ah istuudiyow/gosiwon la heli karo

h-6: Gudaha 5 daqiiqo oo lug ah boosteejada tareenka ama baska
h-7: Kharashka dayactirka iyo biilasha oo cad oo jaban
h-8: Meel baabuurta la dhigto iyo wiish laga heli karo dhismo casri ah
h-9: Hoy u oggol xayawaanka rabaayada ah (eyda, bisadaha waa la oggol yahay)
h-10: Wareejinta kireysiga kahor waqtiga & caawinta soo celinta deebaajiga
bank-1: Wehelin furashada koontada bangiga iyadoo la adeegsanayo ARC / Baasaboor
bank-2: Codsi kaarka debit-ka oo leh shaqada gaadiidka ee T-money
bank-3: Bangiga mobilka, Shahaadada dijitaalka ah & dejinta OTP
bank-4: Kordhinta xadka xawaaladaha caalamiga ah & diiwaangelinta qofka qaadanaya
bank-5: Dib u soo saarista buugga/kaarka lumay & daabacaadda xisaab-xidhka bangiga
bank-6: Dib u dejinta khaladaadka erayga sirta ah ee 5 jeer & furista koontada xayiran
bank-7: U qoondeynta koontada mushaharka & dejinta bixinta tooska ah

insur-1: Hubinta u-qalmitaanka Caymiska Caafimaadka Qaranka & wehelin diiwaangelinta
insur-2: Caymiska qasabka ah ee shaqaalaha ajnabiga ah (Dammaanadda bixitaanka / Shilalka)
insur-3: La-talinta caymiska caafimaadka gaarka ah & daboolida kharashka isbitaalka
insur-4: Dejinta caymiska qasabka ah & kan guud ee baabuurta / mootooyinka
insur-5: Hagaha dalbashada lacagta caymiska & tarjumaadda dukumentiyada caafimaadka
insur-6: Dib u habaynta caymiska marka fiisuhu isbeddelo & soo celinta lacagta hadhay
insur-7: La-talinta qorshaha caymiska ilkaha, kansarka & qalliinnada waaweyn
insur-8: Weydiinta & qaadashada faa'iidooyinka caymiska ee aan la dalban kahor inta aan dalka lagu laaban
job-1: Wax-soo-saarka / Shaqada warshadda & isku-dubbaridka (Hoyga waa la bixinayaa)
job-2: Kaaliyaha jikada maqaayadda / Adeegaha miiska / Cunto-kariye (Ajaanibta waa la soo dhoweynayaa)
job-3: Dhismaha / Qurxinta gudaha: nijaarnimo, bir-xirid, koronto iyo tuubbooyinka biyaha
job-4: Ganacsiga / Bakhaarka saadka: soo-dejinta iyo dhoofinta, wadista fargeetada iyo baakadeynta
job-5: Turjumaad / Maamulka xafiiska / Suuqgeynta caalamiga ah / Xirfadle ganacsi dibadeed
job-6: Dib-u-eegista heshiiska shaqada (Mushaharka, saacadaha shaqada, 4-ta caymis ee bulshada ugu waaweyn)
job-7: Mushahar aan la bixin, lacagta howlgabka iyo la-socoshada la-talinta sharciga khilaafaadka shaqada
job-8: Loo-shaqeeyayaasha: Shaqaaleysiinta shaqaale ajnabi ah oo sharciyeysan, dadaal badan oo lagu kalsoonaan karo
hosp-1: Ballan-qabsashada iyo is-diiwaangelinta isbitaalka guud ama kan jaamacadda
hosp-2: Turjumaadda iyo la-socoshada daaweynta ilkaha: godadka ilkaha, xidid-saarka, iyo bixinta iligga
hosp-3: Turjumaadda lafaha jaban, dhabar xanuunka, iyo jimicsiga daaweynta (fiziyoterabi)
hosp-4: Turjumaadda cudurrada gudaha / dhuunta, sanka & dhegaha: hargabka, calool-xanuunka, iyo baaritaanka endoskobiga
hosp-5: Baaritaanka caafimaadka haweenka / kaadi-mareenka iyo la-tashiga gaarka ah ee dhakhtarka oo la turjumayo
hosp-6: Sharaxaadda warbixinta baaritaanka caafimaadka guud ee qaranka oo lagu bixinayo afka hooyo
hosp-7: Taageerada iyo la-socoshada qolka xaaladaha degdegga ah (ER) habeenkii ama maalmaha fasaxa
hosp-8: Turjumaadda qiyaasta daawada farmashiyaha, dhibaatooyinka ay keeni karto, iyo tilmaamaha qaadashada
mob-1: Furashada SIM-kaar jaban oo leh xaqiijinta aqoonsiga buuxa ee ajaanibta
mob-2: Dib-u-buuxinta degdegga ah ee SIM-kaarka lacagta hore loo bixiyo iyo xirmooyinka internet-ka aan xadidnayn
mob-3: Isqorista cusub ee shirkadaha isgaarsiinta waaweyn (SKT/KT/LGU+) iyo cusboonaysiinta taleefannada casriga ah
mob-4: Rakibaadda internet-ka xawaaraha sare leh ee fiber-ka iyo Giga Wi-Fi ee qolka/guriga
mob-5: Furista taleefanka khidmadda aan la bixin darteed loo xiray, wareejinta lahaanshaha, iyo qaadashada lambarka (MNP)
mob-6: Rakibaadda barnaamijka xaqiijinta aqoonsiga ee PASS iyo caawinta xaqiijinta aqoonsiga taleefanka
mob-7: Beddelidda shaashadda jaban, baytariga, iyo la-socoshada xarunta rasmiga ah ee adeegga
mob-8: Barnaamijyada taleefan-u-dirista caalamiga ah ee qiimaha jaban iyo dib-u-buuxinta kuubannada xogta internet-ka
